ops.text: INDEMNITY BY LICENSOR. Licensor shall defend and indemnify Licensee and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Licensed Technology, the Documentation or any other materials or services supplied by Licensor infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) Licensor's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee's data caused by Licensor; or (iv) Licensor's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense, and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation. The exclusions and limitations of liability in Article XIII do not apply to Licensor's obligations under this paragraph.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XII runs one way only and Article XIII expressly excludes Licensor liability for infringement, so we carry all IP risk in technology we do not control. We have added a Licensor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, Licensor-caused data incidents and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with notice, control and cooperation, and narrowed our own indemnity to our content and our breach of applicable law; if helpful, we can discuss the usual exclusions and a super-cap as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Add Licensor IP/misconduct defence and indemnity and narrow Licensee's one-way indemnity to Licensee content and breach of law
